_doc: Evidence that each pinned engine READS every key our launchers write into its own config file. Checked by scripts/lib/profiles/engine_config_reads.py (gate: scripts/tests/test-engine-config-reads.sh); the tool's docstring has the rules. After an engine pin bump, run: python3 scripts/lib/profiles/engine_config_reads.py verify <engine> --record

setup_only.CONTEXT: the entrypoint passes it to setup.py as --max-context (setup owns it: it sizes the KV and expert cache); strata_config.py only compares it
setup_only.KV: the entrypoint passes it to setup.py as --kv; strata_config.py only compares it

reads.reasoning_effort: main(): the server's default effort for requests that name none (logged 'thinking level: ...')
reads.reasoning_budget_tokens: main(): Service.reasoning_budget_tokens, the thinking cap for every request
reads.sampling.temperature: sampling_defaults_from_config(): a default for requests that leave the field out
reads.args:--spec: the engine's own flag: the MTP drafter's verify window

reads.reasoning_effort: main(): svc.default_effort (logged 'thinking level when a request names none: ...')
reads.sampling.temperature: sampling_defaults_from_config(): a default for requests that leave the field out
reads.args:--kv: the engine's own flag (its GLM path reads only int8: the launcher refuses q4_0 / k8v4, a value rule this gate doesn't check)
reads.args:--max-context: the engine's own flag: KV/state capacity

not_config_writers.scripts/lib/effort_budget.py: prints shell variables the vLLM / SGLang composes put on their own command line; it writes no engine config file
not_config_writers.models/qwen3.8-flash-next/bucko-vllm/pat: patches bucko's vLLM source with a default thinking budget; it writes no engine config file
